visualReview.purpose: Reviewed fundal descent/assessment, pad saturation and erroneous mass-volume conversion, cervical appearance, prolapse/fistula diagrams and family interaction image. Image-only pages contain no hidden medication table or treatment protocol.

emphasis.handling: Exact phrases only; no Markdown/HTML is inserted into the authored notes. Earlier CSV flags, decisions and ten Week 6 additions remain unchanged.

materialLimits.handling: Original PDFs list infection categories but not complete diagnostic/antibiotic regimens; brief clinical clarification differentiates site findings, mastitis care and sepsis response. Prescribed drug choices and source-control plans remain individualized.

Original PDFs provide risk factors and the no-Homan warning but no diagnostic/anticoagulant protocol; brief labeled clarification connects symptoms with urgent evaluation and ordered prevention/treatment.

Original material names massage, oxytocin, methylergonovine and carboprost but lacks full staged response/doses/contraindications. Essential response and medication-safety clarifications are included; no new dosing or surgical protocol is supplied.
The slides name delayed bleeding, retained tissue and infection without a full workup; nursing preparation/evaluation is explained without inventing a diagnostic algorithm.

clarifications.issue: Fever/tachycardia and increased blood volume presented as reassurance
clarifications.handling: Interpret trends and assess fever ≥38°C at any point; normal BP or initial hemoglobin cannot exclude hemorrhage.

clarifications.issue: Lochia pad categories and 500 mL = 454 g conversion
clarifications.handling: Separate visual saturation cues from quantification; subtract dry weight and use approximately 1 g = 1 mL added blood weight.
Distinguish lecture thresholds from ACOG definition, with action before a threshold when clinically indicated.

clarifications.issue: Uterotonics named without safety checks; incomplete response
clarifications.handling: Clarify methylergonovine/HTN and carboprost/asthma precautions, parallel resuscitation/cause control and ordered early TXA as an antifibrinolytic.

clarifications.issue: Breast binding/deep massage and extra pumping
clarifications.handling: Support nonconstricting bra, cold and normal effective feeding; avoid deep massage/binding/forced emptying.

clarifications.issue: Routine urine interruption and universal cesarean clear-liquid/ambulation rules
clarifications.handling: Empty-bladder pelvic-floor practice and individualized diet/mobility/voiding plans.

clarifications.issue: Handout implies routine bedside uterine sweeping
clarifications.handling: Uterine exploration/removal is clinician-led and indication-specific, not routine nursing recovery care.

clarifications.issue: MMR egg/shedding wording, broad Rh dosing and lactational infertility
clarifications.handling: Clarify MMR/breastfeeding and 28-day pregnancy avoidance, unsensitized Rh-negative/Rh-positive eligibility and 72-hour prophylaxis, and all LAM criteria.

clarifications.issue: One postpartum visit/fixed restriction or universal sterilization rule
clarifications.handling: Earlier individualized follow-up with contact by 3 weeks and comprehensive care by 12 weeks; avoid universal restrictions or legal claims.

clarifications.issue: Infection equated with sepsis in fixed time window
clarifications.handling: Differentiate infection from organ dysfunction, including possible sepsis without fever and urgent treatment.

clarifications.issue: Depression/intrusive thoughts automatically progress to psychosis; screening scales conflated
clarifications.handling: Distinguish duration/function, insight/reality testing and immediate danger; name BDI-II versus EPDS/PHQ-9 without importing diagnostic cutoffs.

sharedViews: All twelve answers are reused in Week 8. Six appear on normal-postpartum and six on postpartum-complications. Original topic order, question banks/maps, practice shortcuts, TikToks, materials layout and navigation are unchanged.
limits: Source-led educational notes with clearly labeled clinical safety/care clarifications. Automated checks verify coverage, original-source integrity, earlier-note preservation and rendering; these are not independent clinical validation or a bedside order set.
